title: Kites Above the Clover
description: Climb from clover into kite-filled wind, then cross the exposed ridge above the valley.

signs.text:
Clover beneath the strings
Keep your first jumps low

The windy hillside
Rise with the hillside · brake into the wind

The kite field
Ride the thermal · leave it sideways

The high ridge
Reverse once around the rocky shoulder

The exposed hilltop
Cross the last wind-cut gaps

identity.scope: Decoration reference route; not a final five-minute stage
